mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 5% YoY signals inflationary pressures that lead to tighter monetary policy, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower in periods of high CPIAUCSL YoY growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower in periods of sharp UNRATE increases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower in periods of declining RSAFS (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% in one month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of strong INDPRO growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower when both conditions are met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) is increasing, the combination signals a tight labor market with strong job growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher when both conditions are met (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of increasing HOUST (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and industrial production (INDPRO) is declining, the combination signals a supply-side recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative for 2 quarters and INDPRO declining
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower when both conditions are met (t-test p > 0.05).
